notes:
Account: Cascade Sentinel Systems (clinical workflow SaaS for regional hospitals). Interested in Private (VPC) deployment + Dedicated fallback. Primary driver: process PHI and PII with strict residency and audit controls.

Recent timeline: 
- 2026-01-20: Intro call (AE Jordan) — high-level product fit, confirmed need for private control plane.
- 2026-02-02: Technical discovery with infra + security (SE Riya). Discussed network topology, VPC peering, and egress controls.
- 2026-02-18: Procurement kickoff; vendor risk intake packet requested (SIG/CAIQ).
- 2026-02-25: Submitted initial SIG partial responses; security team asked for clarifications on key management and audit retention.
- 2026-03-01: Security deep-dive (Fireflies ff-20260301-cascade-security-deepdive-0047). Customer wants HSM-backed keys, BYOK support, and per-tenant audit logging retained 7 years.

Use-case / Requirements summary: 
- Workloads: clinical summarization pipelines, patient support chat (HIPAA-adjacent), index/query of medical documents (embeddings + reranking).
- Latency target: 100-250ms tail for chat; batch embeddings throughput target 3k reqs/hr.
- Cost sensitivity: medium — willing to pay uplift for private deployment if SLA and compliance are met.
- Model preferences: open Llama-2 family initially; willing to evaluate quantized variants. Need model version pinning and rollout controls.
- Routing / fallback: primary in VPC private nodes (us-east-1), fallback to Dedicated in same region for burst.

Security questionnaire / Vendor risk notes: 
- SIG/CAIQ: 70% complete; pending answers on key lifecycle, BYOK proof, and data deletion guarantees. Need to attach SOC2 Type II and relevant iso27001 excerpts to the intake.
- Shared responsibility: customer requires clear doc mapping network controls (customer-managed VPC, subnets, NACLs) vs Redwood responsibilities (inference runtime, control-plane auth, audit log delivery). Draft provided 2026-03-05; security asked for explicit KMS flow diagram.
- KMS integration: Customer requires external KMS/HSM with customer-owned keys (BYOK). Action: schedule KMS workshop to validate Redwood support for external key wrap/unwrapping, rotation, and key escrow policies.
- Audit logging & retention: Must deliver immutable audit logs (access, admin actions, token-level usage metadata) to customer's centralized SIEM over TLS and retain per policy. Confirmed support for log forwarding via secure syslog/CloudWatch ingestion.
- Data residency: All inference data must remain in us-east-1 region with no cross-region backups. Need attestation for backup behavior.

Quotes / snippets from calls: 
- "We cannot accept any control-plane logs leaving the US region without an explicit data processing addendum." — Head of Security.
- "BYOK is a hard requirement — legal will not sign otherwise." — Procurement director.

Open action items: 
- AE/Jordan: Provide completed SIG baseline (include SOC2 artifacts) by 2026-03-12.
- SE/Riya: Produce KMS integration diagram + runbook; confirm rotation and destruction behaviors.
- Infra workshop: Coordinate calendar for week of 2026-03-16 (target).
- Legal: Prep DPA/Data residency language; respond to procurement list.

Procurement / commercial notes: 
- Estimated ARR band: $200k–$500k.
- Procurement expects a dedicated SOW and SLA (99.95% uptime for private nodes) and incident MTTR commitments.

Next meeting planned: Technical KMS workshop + SIG Q&A (30–45m).
